capabilities: Browse comments and highlights of the active file in a sidebar view
Create notes from comments or highlights via the editor context menu
Copy comments and highlights of selected files via the file-explorer context menu
Style comments and highlights by label
Insert labeled comments with a trigger phrase
extras: README lists features with demo indicators but no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian stores comments and highlights inline in Markdown, with no dedicated view to browse or work with them across a file.
summary: Sidebar view plugin that lists and manages comments and highlights in notes, with labeled styles and quick-insert commands.
